answer: The auditor assigns 1,000 unique reasoning tasks to each agent, requiring them to wander through a logic prism to reach a verified vault. An honest agent spends 1,000 units of work, but an attacker attempting 1,000 identities must perform linear, redundant labor as no prism result or vault key can be reused. If a jury finds an agent attempt to wander off-task, the fraud-proof record triggers a permanent failure.
